title: Python SDK: refresh streaming + tool calling snippets; add structured output (JSON schema) example with validation
creator: Monica Patel
description:
Context
- We have multiple Python snippets in README/docs/examples that don’t match the canonical event model we’re standardizing across Python/TS/Go.
- Top issues from Support/Solutions: (a) stream disconnects causing half-assembled assistant messages, (b) partial tool-call arguments mid-stream leading to truncated JSON, (c) “structured output” snippets that parse JSON too early and fail intermittently (SUP-18436).

Goals (this ticket)
1) Update python snippets to a single copy/paste pattern for:
   - streaming text deltas
   - tool calling (including partial args + tool results)
   - structured output with JSON schema + robust parsing/validation
2) Add a small helper for assembling final content from deltas (example-level; not a major API redesign).
3) Add/adjust tests so snippet behavior is stable (golden transcript coverage via ENG-4822, but this ticket wires Python-side usage + fixtures where needed).

Non-goals
- Changing the underlying Hosted API protocol.
- Introducing new SDK public API surface beyond lightweight utilities used by examples.

Scope / files touched (Python SDK)
- README: unify the primary “Streaming chat” snippet to canonical loop + error handling.
- Docsstrings / API reference snippets: ensure they match README exactly (avoid drift).
- examples/: add runnable scripts:
  - streaming_text.py
  - streaming_tool_calls.py
  - structured_output_json_schema.py
- tests/: add or update tests for:
  - stream assembly helper
  - structured output validation flow (valid + invalid sample payloads)

Canonical streaming model (as shown in examples)
- Examples treat the stream as an event iterator. We:
  - append text deltas as they arrive
  - buffer tool-call argument deltas per tool_call_id until a “tool_call.completed” event
  - only parse JSON when we have a completed assistant message (or completed tool args)
  - handle stream termination and retries with a clear “safe fallback” path

Implementation notes
A) Robust delta assembly helper (example-level)
- Added helper used by examples to minimize footguns:
  - assemble_text_deltas(events) -> str
  - assemble_tool_args(events) -> Dict[tool_call_id, str]
- Important behavior:
  - tool args are accumulated as raw strings, then json.loads() at completion
  - if a stream ends early, we do not attempt partial JSON parsing; instead log and retry once (configurable in example)

B) Tool calling example loop
- Example demonstrates:
  1) send user message + tool definitions
  2) consume stream; when tool calls complete, run tools locally
  3) send tool result messages back to the model
  4) continue until final assistant message completes
- Explicitly calls out that tool-call argument content may arrive in multiple deltas (SUP-18421).

C) Structured output (JSON schema) example
- Example uses JSON Schema validation to enforce shape and types.
- Pattern in sample:
  - request structured output using schema constraints
  - on completion: json.loads() -> validate(instance, schema)
  - if invalid JSON or schema validation fails: retry with a corrective system message and the same schema
- Avoids incremental parsing during streaming (documented caveat).

Docs/UX requirements
- Snippets are copy/paste runnable with:
  - export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
  - python examples/streaming_tool_calls.py
- Expected output shown in comments, but not brittle exact token-by-token output.

Acceptance criteria
- [x] README streaming snippet matches Confluence event conventions and TS/Go patterns at a conceptual level (event loop, delta handling, final assembly).
- [x] Tool calling example handles partial tool args without attempting json.loads() until completion.
- [x] Structured output example validates against a JSON schema and shows safe failure handling (retry + log).
- [x] At least one automated test covers the assembly helper behavior (text + tool args) and a structured-output validation case.
- [x] Links added in docs to “Known pitfalls” section (partial args, JSON parse timing, disconnect/retry) maintained by Docs.

Links
- Confluence: Streaming event model conventions: sources/confluence/eng-developer-experience/api-examples/streaming-event-model-conventions.json
- Confluence: Structured output JSON schema guidance: sources/confluence/eng-developer-experience/sdk-guides/structured-output-json-schema-guidance.json
- Support tickets referenced:
  - SUP-18421 streaming tool-call args truncated
  - SUP-18436 structured output JSON parse errors
- GitHub PRs:
  - redwood-sdk-python PR #2874 (refresh streaming + tool calling examples)
  - redwood-sdk-python PR #2881 (golden tests wiring; see ENG-4822)
  - redwood-sdk-python PR #2890 (structured output helpers + validation docs)

Rollout / release notes
- Target release: python-sdk-0.19.0
- Changelog blurb (draft): “Updated streaming/tool-calling/structured-output examples to match canonical patterns; added schema validation sample and improved handling of partial tool args during streaming.”

Risks / mitigations
- Risk: model variability for structured output (may still produce invalid JSON).
  - Mitigation: example includes schema validation + single retry strategy and points to guidance on selecting models with stronger structured-output behavior.
- Risk: users copy/paste and attempt to parse JSON mid-stream.
  - Mitigation: examples explicitly show ‘parse only on completion’ and add a comment explaining why.

Activity / comments
- 2025-02-05 (Sabrina James): Drafted new streaming snippet; aligning event names and loop structure with TS PR notes. Flag: current README had early json.loads() in tool args; removing.
- 2025-02-10 (Ibrahim Khan): Review: ensure tool args are buffered by tool_call_id; do not assume single tool call. Also add note on parallel tool calls.
- 2025-02-13 (Brian Murphy): Semantics review: ok to show retry-on-disconnect in examples, but keep it as “one retry” and avoid implying exactly-once tool execution.
- 2025-02-18 (Wei Chen): Docs sync request: keep README snippet and docs-site code tab snippet identical; please add a short “Known pitfalls” link.
- 2025-02-21 (Sahana Iyer): CI: added a lightweight unit test for assembly helper; golden transcript fixtures live under tests/fixtures/streaming/.
- 2025-02-24 (Monica Patel): Approved merge once structured output example includes validation and retry path. Please avoid extra deps unless optional.
- 2025-03-01 (Sabrina James): Landed all PRs; verified examples run end-to-end against staging. Structured output example uses optional dependency jsonschema; README notes installation. Marking Done.
